card.name: Last digit of a dose before mg
card.fires_on: The final digit (usually 0 or 5) of a multi-digit number in a dose, right before the model expects the unit mg. Seen in dosing tables and directions such as 500 mg or 75 mg/kg.

modes.label: Round hundreds before mg
modes.description: The final 0 of a number like 500, 250 or 400 that is followed by mg.

modes.label: Ending in 5 before mg
modes.description: The final 5 of a number like 75 or 1,875 followed by mg.
modes.example: is: TECENTRIQ HYBREZA 15 mL (1,87<<5>> mg atezolizumab and

card.writes: It promotes the unit mg in its different spellings and suppresses computing units like GB.
card.plain: It fires on the last digit of a dose number when the next word is expected to be mg.
